class.name: ReloadedProjectSetting
class.brief_description: Registers a project setting with its default value and its hint.
class.description: The editor shows a registered setting and the running game knows its default: a setting at its default value is not saved in [code]project.godot[/code]. Each setting is registered once, by its owner, from the constant it reads - one read in C++ as the library starts, before [UserSettings] applies the player's values; one read in GDScript by its library's list ([code]ReloadedProjectSettings[/code]) in the editor and as the game starts.

method.name: add
method.description: Registers [param name] with [param default_value] as its initial value, of [param type], with [param hint] and [param hint_string] for the editor. A value [code]project.godot[/code] gives the setting is kept.
